objective: Decisions 0097 and 0098 in the arena: the ring, the shield and warnings, pops, the camera, the boss, sounds and music, the slow-motion finish, the reward moment and the run's boon pick.
acceptance_criteria: A ring closes on a full power plate and a tap as it closes shows PERFECT
A warning ring shows before an enemy power attack and the shield button blocks it
Power attacks cut the camera in with the move's name; the last hit is slow motion only
The result shows stars, a coin burst and the MVP; a win offers three boons that start the next wave
